name: task-runner-context
goal: Preserve trusted sandbox context through the task process without exposing provider keys

evidence: A synthetic child of taskProcess received none of the supplied CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, CODEX_HOME or HARNESS_TASK_CONTRACT_SNAPSHOT values; a synthetic API key remained excluded.

The existing forwarding case mocks execute and never observes the spawned child environment. Strengthen that case with a disposable child and synthetic context and key values; keep its title and count.
